reservation_id, performance_round_id, reservation_no, lookup_token_hash, entry_token_hash, applicant_name_ciphertext, phone_ciphertext, phone_search_hash, encryption_key_version, status_code, privacy_policy_version_id, agreed_dttm, cancelled_dttm, cancel_reason, personal_data_erased_dttm, created_dttm, updated_dttm
reservation_seat_id, reservation_id, performance_round_seat_id, status_code, cancelled_dttm, cancel_reason, checked_in_dttm, checked_in_by_member_id, created_dttm, updated_dttm
mapper.select: SELECT FROM performance_round_seat WHERE performance_round_seat_id = #{performanceRoundSeatId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM performance_round_seat WHERE performance_round_id = #{performanceRoundId} ORDER BY COALESCE(display_row, 2147483647), COALESCE(display_column, 2147483647), seat_label, performance_round_seat_id

SELECT prs.performance_round_seat_id, prs.performance_round_id, prs.seat_label, prs.section_code, prs.row_label, prs.column_label, prs.display_row, prs.display_column, prs.status_code, prs.accessibility_code, prs.created_dttm, prs.updated_dttm FROM performance_round_seat prs LEFT JOIN active_seat_occupancy occupancy ON occupancy.performance_round_seat_id = prs.performance_round_seat_id WHERE prs.performance_round_id = #{performanceRoundId} AND prs.status_code = 'AVAILABLE' AND occupancy.performance_round_seat_id IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(prs.display_row, 2147483647), COALESCE(prs.display_column, 2147483647), prs.seat_label, prs.performance_round_seat_id
SELECT FROM reservation WHERE lookup_token_hash = #{lookupTokenHash} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reservation WHERE entry_token_hash = #{entryTokenHash} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reservation WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reservation_seat WHERE reservation_seat_id = #{reservationSeatId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reservation_seat WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY reservation_seat_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT rs.reservation_seat_id, rs.performance_round_seat_id, seat.seat_label, seat.section_code, seat.row_label, seat.column_label, rs.status_code, rs.checked_in_dttm, rs.checked_in_by_member_id FROM reservation_seat rs JOIN performance_round_seat seat ON seat.performance_round_seat_id = rs.performance_round_seat_id WHERE rs.reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY COALESCE(seat.display_row, 2147483647), COALESCE(seat.display_column, 2147483647), seat.seat_label, rs.reservation_seat_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS reservation_count, COALESCE(SUM(summary.seat_count), 0) AS reserved_seat_count, COALESCE(SUM(summary.checked_in_count), 0) AS checked_in_seat_count, COALESCE(SUM( summary.seat_count - summary.checked_in_count ), 0) AS not_checked_in_seat_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN summary.checked_in_count > 0 AND summary.checked_in_count < summary.seat_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS partially_checked_in_reservation_count, ROUND(COALESCE( SUM(summary.checked_in_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(summary.seat_count), 0), 0 ), 2) AS entry_rate FROM ( SELECT r.reservation_id, COUNT(rs.reservation_seat_id) AS seat_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rs.checked_in_dttm IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checked_in_count FROM reservation r JOIN reservation_seat rs ON rs.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND rs.status_code = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE r.performance_round_id = #{performanceRoundId} AND r.status_code <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY r.reservation_id ) summary

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.performance_round_id, r.reservation_no, r.lookup_token_hash, r.entry_token_hash, r.applicant_name_ciphertext, r.phone_ciphertext, r.phone_search_hash, r.encryption_key_version, r.status_code, r.privacy_policy_version_id, r.agreed_dttm, r.cancelled_dttm, r.cancel_reason, r.personal_data_erased_dttm, r.created_dttm, r.updated_dttm FROM reservation r JOIN performance_round round_info ON round_info.performance_round_id = r.performance_round_id WHERE r.personal_data_erased_dttm IS NULL AND round_info.start_dttm < #{cutoffDttm} ORDER BY round_info.start_dttm, r.reservation_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( performance_round_id, reservation_no, lookup_token_hash, entry_token_hash, applicant_name_ciphertext, phone_ciphertext, phone_search_hash, encryption_key_version, status_code, privacy_policy_version_id, agreed_dttm, cancelled_dttm, cancel_reason, personal_data_erased_dttm ) VALUES ( #{performanceRoundId}, #{reservationNo}, #{lookupTokenHash}, #{entryTokenHash}, #{applicantNameCiphertext}, #{phoneCiphertext}, #{phoneSearchHash}, #{encryptionKeyVersion}, #{status}, #{privacyPolicyVersionId}, #{agreedDttm}, #{cancelledDttm}, #{cancelReason}, #{personalDataErasedDttm} )
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET lookup_token_hash = #{lookupTokenHash}, entry_token_hash = #{entryTokenHash}, applicant_name_ciphertext = #{applicantNameCiphertext}, phone_ciphertext = #{phoneCiphertext}, phone_search_hash = #{phoneSearchHash}, status_code = #{status}, cancelled_dttm = #{cancelledDttm}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, personal_data_erased_dttm = #{personalDataErasedDttm} WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}

UPDATE reservation_seat SET status_code = #{status}, cancelled_dttm = #{cancelledDttm}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, checked_in_dttm = #{checkedInDttm}, checked_in_by_member_id = #{checkedInByMemberId} WHERE reservation_seat_id = #{reservationSeatId}
mapper.delete: DELETE occupancy FROM active_seat_occupancy occupancy JOIN reservation_seat rs ON rs.reservation_seat_id = occupancy.reservation_seat_id WHERE rs.reservation_id = #{reservationId}
